description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

descriptions.zh:
## 请求说明
- 本接口用于移除指定域名的serverHold状态。
descriptions.en:
## Description

- This operation removes the serverHold status of a specified domain name.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns remove-rsp-domain-server-hold-status-for-gateway --client-token asdf --domain-name example.com --status-msg '实名认证通过，解除serverHold状态' --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns RemoveRspDomainServerHoldStatusForGateway --region cn-hangzhou --StatusMsg '实名认证通过，解除serverHold状态' --DomainName 'example.com' --ClientToken asdf
